name: Northdale
summary: Northdale lies in ruins north of Light's Hope Chapel, near the border of Quel'Thalas. Banshees, hidden watchers, and corrupted elementals haunt its streets. Here, Taelan Fordring left the Order of the Silver Hand for the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: A Town of Sorrow
sections.body: Northdale lies among the hills north of Light's Hope Chapel, beside the northern highway to Quel'Thalas. The Third War shattered this once peaceful town. Its people were slain or driven away, and its hearths went cold. Now wailing banshees drift among the broken walls. Invisible Eyeless Watchers watch the cursed roads from the dark. The nearby lake has fallen to the plague, too, and corrupted water elementals churn its waters.

sections.title: The Forsaken Oath
sections.body: After Lordaeron fell and the Knights of the Silver Hand dissolved, young Taelan Fordring stood in Northdale's broken streets. He cast aside his father's teachings. Taelan believed the Silver Hand's remnants were too weak to purge the undead scourge, so he abandoned his sacred duty and joined the radical Scarlet Crusade. His choice shaped the crusade's hold over Hearthglen.

faq.answer: The Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War and destroyed Northdale. Its buildings were razed and its people fell to the plague. Now stone ruins remain, haunted by vengeful spirits and corrupted elementals.

faq.q: What significant event took place here?
aliases: order of the silver hand northdale
faq.answer: In Northdale, Taelan Fordring renounced the Order of the Silver Hand. Despairing over Lordaeron's fall, he cast aside his paladin vows and pledged himself to the emerging Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: What creatures haunt the ruins today?
faq.answer: Wailing banshees and unseen Eyeless Watchers serving the Scourge haunt Northdale's ruins. Corrupted water elementals infest the nearby waters.
Northdale lies in the northeastern Eastern Plaguelands, north of Light's Hope Chapel and southeast of the Thalassian Pass into Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: As a paladin, you stand on the soil where Taelan Fordring abandoned the Silver Hand to pursue vengeance. Northdale is a solemn reminder of lost faith.
As a human, you see Northdale's burnt foundations and wandering banshees. They mark another Lordaeron community slaughtered and claimed by the Scourge.
